text_block_list.text:
Excuse me? Hello? Trainer, are you
here?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Excuse me? Hello? Trainer, are you
here?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I was wondering if you had a sewing kit.
Grass's
uniform is a little frayed.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Great! Thanks!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: I'm sorry for the inconvenience.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Just you hold still, Grass. I'll fix you right
up.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
What? No, I can handle it myself. You
don't have
to do all this...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
It's okay, don't be shy! I happen to like
sewing,
you know! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
W-well, in that case, I would very much

appreciate it.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
With practiced hands, Марузенски
mends Grass
Wonder's uniform
flawlessly.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Okay, that should do it! A pretty good
job, if I
say so myself! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I couldn't help
noticing how
carefully and skillfully you
worked.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Your attention to detail far exceeds my
own...
You really are incredible,
Марузенски.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Oh, stop. You're making me blush! I'm
glad that
you feel you can count on me,
though.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty well-versed in practical skills
like this,
so just give me a shout
whenever you need
help! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
My mom and our maid. They taught me a
lot of
things when I was a little girl.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Like how you shouldn't always rely on
others. It's
thanks to them that I learned
to do things for
myself.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
That's right. You live by yourself outside
the
academy, not in the dorm, right?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Your mom and the teachers must trust
that you
can take good care of yourself.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Oh! Uh, y-yeah, right... I'm super
independent...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: ...Did I say something strange?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: No, not at all! Don't worry about it!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
choice_data_list: You've always been a strong person.
Isn't it hard to live alone?

text_block_list.text:
I guess so! People have been telling me
that for a
long time.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I always did household chores with our
maid
rather than just letting her take
care of me...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
And in school, I tried to help the
younger
students. I was quite popular.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
As a child, you must have been a
reliable,
older-sister type, just like you
are now.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
That's right. I would even try to help out
the older
students at times.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I've often been told that I come off
older than I
actually am... I guess I just
exude an aura of
maturity!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Really?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I've just always liked being counted on.
I'll lend a
hand with anything.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Big Sister Марузенски is ready to help in
two
shakes of a lamb's tail!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: In two... shakes?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
And don't you forget it, Grass!
Heehee! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Well, helping people out so much does
tend to
keep me busy...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
In our case, we also have academic work
and
racing to deal with. It must be
difficult to balance
it all with daily
chores.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't worry. I enjoy doing it, so it's
no bother
at all.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Besides, I'm making sure to take
breathers every
day!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: You do?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
That's right. And when I say breather... I
mean a
drive!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
If I'm having a bad day or feeling
stressed out...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I just take Tata for a spin and leave all
that in the
dust!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Though... driving by myself isn't always
enough,
so I usually try to take someone
with me.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Ah, I suppose you can rely on your
trainer to go
on drives with you.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Heehee! I'm glad to hear we're on the
same page!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
The best way to care for me is through
your
actions. I'm counting on your
support! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
There may be more reasons why she
comes off as
older, but it might be
better not to point that
out...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It seems fairly clear that Марузенски will
be
asking me to take a drive in the near
future...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
